periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the black eye patches is oriented diagonally, slanting inward toward the rostrum at approximately a 45-degree angle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patches exhibit an elongated oval morphology with a visual height-to-width ratio of approximately 2:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: A distinct downward tapering is visible, where the patch extends significantly below the ocular center toward the medial-inferior area of the snout.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: The posterior boundary of the transverse dark band exhibits a shallow U-shape with a relatively flat profile across the midline.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is robust, occupying roughly 30-40% of the visible vertical height of the upper torso.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are widely spaced, with a lateral gap approximately equal to the transverse width of the white cranial vault between them.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior margins of the pinnae are smooth and semicircular, showing no visible flattening or irregularities.

other_distinctive_markers: A cylindrical bamboo stalk is held horizontally in the mouth, partially occluding the lower mandible.
